_meta.title: Exodus — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from Exodus (the call of Moses, the exodus and Passover, the Red Sea, the covenant and commandments, and God's presence). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 2 Exodus); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight, proper-name en-dashes to hyphens
_meta.selection: several key verses per substantive chapter; plague, ritual-law, and tabernacle-construction chapters represented lightly or omitted (22 of 40 chapters represented)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.plain: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.

verses.text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.plain: God heard their groaning, and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.plain: 'Do not come any closer,' God said. 'Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.'

verses.text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
verses.plain: God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: I AM has sent me to you.'

verses.text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verses.plain: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say.

verses.text: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.plain: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

verses.text: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.plain: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might show you my power and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

verses.text: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.plain: The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are; and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. No destroying plague will touch you when I strike Egypt.

verses.text: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.plain: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so they could travel by day or night.

verses.text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.plain: Moses answered the people, 'Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today.'

verses.text: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.plain: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

verses.text: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
verses.plain: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father's God, and I will exalt him.

verses.text: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.plain: Who among the gods is like you, Lord? Who is like you — majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?

verses.text: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.plain: Then the Lord said to Moses, 'I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day.'

verses.text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it JEHOVAH-nissi:
verses.plain: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord Is My Banner.

verses.text: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.plain: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession, for the whole earth is mine.

verses.text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.plain: You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.plain: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

verses.text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
verses.plain: Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.plain: See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

verses.text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.plain: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, 'We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey.'

verses.text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.plain: Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

verses.text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.plain: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge, and with all kinds of skills,

verses.text: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.plain: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said, 'Whoever is for the Lord, come to me.' And all the Levites rallied to him.

verses.text: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.plain: The Lord replied, 'My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.'

verses.text: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.plain: And the Lord passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, 'The Lord, the Lord, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.'

verses.text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.plain: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
